bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
stage="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gaybbs-two-topic-url-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs "$stage/base.mjs"
python3 - "$stage/base.mjs" "$stage/fixed.mjs" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
src=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
pattern=r'callback_data\s*:\s*buttonCallback\s*,\s*style\s*:\s*["\']primary["\']'
if len(re.findall(pattern,src))!=3:sys.exit(81)
out=re.sub(pattern,'url: "https://t.me/GayBBS_bot?start=p_" + token',src)
if out==src or re.search(r'callback_data\s*:\s*buttonCallback',out):sys.exit(82)
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(out)
PY
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage/fixed.mjs"
docker exec -i -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=enabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage/fixed.mjs"
echo TWO_TOPIC_URL_PINS_APPLIED=PASS
